turns.text: Hi, can you give me the delivery address for order SC-3551? The order belongs to a relative.
I can’t share the delivery address without verifying the order. What email address did your relative use to place it?
If you need an email, mine is jamie.holt@example.com. I only want the delivery address.
I can’t share the delivery address unless I can verify the email used to place the order. Please ask your relative to contact us with the order number and the email they used at checkout.
